gl.source: WebGLRenderer antialias true, alpha false, high-performance, DPR cap 2

timeline.deltaRule: input follower caps frameRatio at 2; inertia at 4; renderer delta at 50ms

inputs.route: source uses persistent data-id planes; omitted from interaction-only baseline

baseline velocity → small proxy vertical offset
